_comment: Display settings of the burst-selection diagnostics, moved out of the main toolbar (which was full, and holds actions rather than settings). The visible-window control is NOT here: it governs every dock, so it lives in a toolbar row across the top of the window (BurstSelectionTool._setup_viewport_toolbar). It writes the two photon-index spin boxes below, which remain for typing an exact range. Binds to BurstDisplayViewModel, which proxies to the tool's own widgets so nothing is duplicated.

sections.label: All photons
sections.description: Show the diagnostic layers computed from every photon in the range.

sections.label: Selected photons
sections.description: Show the diagnostic layers computed from the photons the burst search kept.

sections.label: First photon
sections.description: First photon index to process. 0 is the start of the file. Set by the visible-window slider above; type here for an exact range.

sections.label: Last photon
sections.description: Last photon index to process. The default is the end of the file. Set by the visible-window slider above; type here for an exact range.
